metadata.description: Hacking programs: 103 software programs for datacoms

programs.name: Sledgehammer
programs.passive: Make a HACKING roll vs target WITS with a SMALL bonus to the hit roll. On hit deal SYSTEM damage. Cannot be OBFUSCATED while this program is active, its brute-force signature is impossible to hide.
programs.active: Make a HACKING roll vs target WITS with a LARGE bonus to the hit roll. On hit deal SYSTEM damage. Cannot be OBFUSCATED.

programs.name: Deep Scan
programs.passive: Make a CYBERINTEL roll vs target WITS. On success reveal 1 program or routine currently running on the target network. Gain 1 additional reveal per success above the hit threshold, up to a maximum equal to your EXPERTISE.
programs.active: Same as passive. In addition spend additional successes to reveal hidden game state: token counts, bid amounts, obfuscation counts, or programs held in memory.

programs.name: Kernel Panic
programs.passive: Make a HACKING roll vs target WITS. On hit apply one CPU DRAIN ailment instance, each instance reduces the target's available CPU by 1. Multiple instances stack and are each saved separately during Phase 1.
programs.active: Same as passive. In addition steal 1 CPU per active CPU DRAIN instance currently on the target, they lose that CPU, you gain it immediately for this round.

programs.name: Ghost Rig
programs.passive: Grants a LARGE bonus to OBFUSCATE checks. Taking control of devices or networks while obfuscated does not reveal your presence, targets have no indication they are being hacked until obfuscation ends or they successfully detect you.
programs.active: All CYBERINTEL, HACKING and OPERATOR rolls made while obfuscated have a critical success on any result of 5 or higher. On a critical success your obfuscation count does not decrease for that action.

programs.name: Override
programs.passive: Make an OPERATOR roll vs the target's WITS (attended drone: use operator's WITS instead). On success apply DISRUPTED, the drone cannot act this round.
programs.active: Make an OPERATOR roll vs the target's WITS. On success the drone is SEIZED, add it to your network immediately, reserving CPU equal to the drone's core component slots. The original operator may contest seizure each maintenance with an opposed OPERATOR roll.

programs.name: Crypto Cat
programs.passive: Make a HACKING roll vs target WITS. On hit deal SYSTEM damage. Steal a number of banked control tokens from the target equal to the SYSTEM damage dealt after mitigation, they lose those tokens, you gain them immediately.
programs.active: Same as passive. This attack gains the XDT property, datacom TECH defense above MEDIUM is treated as MEDIUM for this attack.

programs.name: Nul Protocol
programs.passive: Make a HACKING roll vs target WITS. On hit deal SYSTEM damage. If a single hit exceeds the target's WILLPOWER threshold causing a mental trauma, any operator directly connected to that device simultaneously suffers a MENTAL TRAUMA.
programs.active: Same as passive. In addition any operator who suffers a mental trauma from this attack is also DAZED until next maintenance.
